source: Project-original local content for IELTS 5.0-6.5 vocabulary practice.

questions.explanation_en: Significant means important or large enough to be noticed.
questions.explanation_zh: significant 表示“重要的、显著的”，与 important 最接近。

questions.explanation_en: As a verb, decline can mean to decrease in amount or quality.
questions.explanation_zh: decline 作动词时可表示“下降”，与 decrease 同义。

questions.explanation_en: A benefit is an advantage or positive result.
questions.explanation_zh: benefit 指“好处、益处”，最接近 advantage。

questions.explanation_en: Rapid describes something happening very quickly.
questions.explanation_zh: rapid 表示“快速的”，与 quick 最接近。

questions.explanation_en: To purchase something is to buy it.
questions.explanation_zh: purchase 作动词表示“购买”，即 buy。

questions.explanation_en: To assist someone is to help them.
questions.explanation_zh: assist 表示“帮助”，与 help 同义。

questions.explanation_en: Essential means completely necessary.
questions.explanation_zh: essential 表示“必不可少的”，最接近 necessary。

questions.explanation_en: Accurate information is correct and free from errors.
questions.explanation_zh: accurate 指“准确无误的”，与 correct 最接近。

questions.explanation_en: To maintain something is to keep it in a particular condition.
questions.explanation_zh: maintain 可表示“保持”，与 keep 最接近。

questions.explanation_en: Numerous means existing in large numbers.
questions.explanation_zh: numerous 表示“许多的”，与 many 同义。

questions.explanation_en: To obtain something is to get or acquire it.
questions.explanation_zh: obtain 表示“获得”，最接近 get。

questions.explanation_en: To reduce something is to make it lower or smaller.
questions.explanation_zh: reduce 表示“减少、降低”，与 lower 最接近。

questions.explanation_en: To indicate something is to show or point it out.
questions.explanation_zh: indicate 表示“表明、显示”，与 show 最接近。

questions.explanation_en: Approximately means about, but not exactly.
questions.explanation_zh: approximately 表示“大约”，与 about 最接近。

questions.explanation_en: A challenge can be a difficult task or problem.
questions.explanation_zh: challenge 可指“困难、难题”，与 difficulty 最接近。

questions.explanation_en: A reliable person or thing can be depended on.
questions.explanation_zh: reliable 表示“可靠的”，与 dependable 同义。

questions.explanation_en: To prevent something is to stop it from happening.
questions.explanation_zh: prevent 表示“阻止”，与 stop 最接近。

questions.explanation_en: To require something is to need it.
questions.explanation_zh: require 表示“需要”，与 need 同义。

questions.explanation_en: A consequence is a result of an action or situation.
questions.explanation_zh: consequence 指“后果、结果”，与 result 最接近。

questions.explanation_en: Considerable means large in amount, degree, or importance.
questions.explanation_zh: considerable 表示“相当大的”，与 large 最接近。

questions.prompt: Regular exercise can ___ improve mental health. (SIGNIFICANT)
questions.explanation_en: An adverb is needed to modify the verb improve.
questions.explanation_zh: 修饰动词 improve 需要副词 significantly。

questions.prompt: The city needs a more ___ transport system. (RELY)
questions.explanation_en: An adjective is needed before the noun transport system.
questions.explanation_zh: 名词短语 transport system 前需要形容词 reliable。

questions.prompt: The report highlights the ___ of clean water. (IMPORTANT)
questions.explanation_en: The article the requires the noun importance here.
questions.explanation_zh: 定冠词 the 后需要名词 importance。

questions.prompt: Online courses offer greater ___ to rural students. (ACCESS)
questions.explanation_en: Offer requires the noun access as its object.
questions.explanation_zh: 动词 offer 后作宾语需要名词 access。

questions.explanation_en: An adverb is needed to describe how the policy was introduced.
questions.explanation_zh: 修饰 introduced 需要副词 successfully。

questions.prompt: Air pollution is a serious ___ problem. (ENVIRONMENT)
questions.explanation_en: The adjective environmental modifies problem.
questions.explanation_zh: 修饰名词 problem 需要形容词 environmental。

questions.prompt: There has been a steady ___ in demand. (GROW)
questions.explanation_en: The article a and adjective steady require a noun.
questions.explanation_zh: a steady 后需要名词 growth。

questions.prompt: The museum is easily ___ by public transport. (ACCESS)
questions.explanation_en: The linking verb is requires the adjective accessible.
questions.explanation_zh: 系动词 is 后需要形容词 accessible。

questions.prompt: The lecturer gave a clear ___ of the process. (EXPLAIN)
questions.explanation_en: The phrase a clear requires the noun explanation.
questions.explanation_zh: a clear 后需要名词 explanation。

questions.explanation_en: The plural subject needs the base-form verb oppose.
questions.explanation_zh: 主语 residents 后需要谓语动词 oppose。

questions.prompt: The data must be checked for ___. (ACCURATE)
questions.explanation_en: The preposition for is followed by the noun accuracy.
questions.explanation_zh: 介词 for 后需要名词 accuracy。

questions.explanation_en: Economical means cost-effective and fits after becoming.
questions.explanation_zh: becoming 后需要形容词；economical 表示“经济实惠的”。

questions.explanation_en: The findings cause surprise, so the -ing adjective is needed.
questions.explanation_zh: 研究结果令人惊讶，因此用 surprising 修饰 findings。

questions.prompt: The company aims to reduce energy ___. (CONSUME)
questions.explanation_en: The noun consumption is the object of reduce.
questions.explanation_zh: reduce 后作宾语需要名词 consumption。

questions.explanation_en: An adverb is needed to modify the adjective different.
questions.explanation_zh: 修饰形容词 different 需要副词 fundamentally。

questions.prompt: Public ___ of the issue has increased. (AWARE)
questions.explanation_en: The subject of has increased must be the noun awareness.
questions.explanation_zh: 作句子主语需要名词 awareness。

questions.explanation_en: The adverb technically modifies the adjective feasible.
questions.explanation_zh: technically 修饰形容词 feasible，表示“技术上可行”。

questions.explanation_en: An adverb is needed to modify participate.
questions.explanation_zh: 修饰动词 participate 需要副词 actively。

questions.prompt: The scheme could bring major ___ improvements. (SOCIETY)
questions.explanation_en: The adjective social modifies improvements.
questions.explanation_zh: 修饰 improvements 需要形容词 social。

questions.prompt: Researchers measured the ___ of the treatment. (EFFECTIVE)
questions.explanation_en: The phrase the ... of requires the noun effectiveness.
questions.explanation_zh: the ... of 结构中需要名词 effectiveness。
